query_ground_truth.intent: This query searches for a deployment management tool to check server status, logs, and hosting configurations.

requirement_groups.purpose: check deployment status and checks for a reference

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step]: Fetch subscriptions using HOSTINGER_LIST_SUBSCRIPTIONS (primary read to confirm the account is reachable and identify active services).
[Required] [Next Step]: List domain assets using HOSTINGER_LIST_DOMAINS (build an asset inventory to relate to subscriptions where possible).
[Optional (if subscription-to-asset mapping is unclear)] [Next Step]: List sites using HOSTINGER_LIST_WEBSITES (cross-check domain↔site relationships; paginate with page/per_page until complete).
[Optional (if DNS inspection is needed for a selected domain)] [Next Step]: Retrieve DNS configuration using HOSTINGER_GET_DNS_RECORDS (validate current zone state for troubleshooting).
[Optional (if billing/order context is needed)] [Next Step]: List purchases using HOSTINGER_LIST_ORDERS (add order-level context for renewals and service correlation).

[Fallback (if a domain appears inaccessible or DNS data is unexpectedly empty)] [Fallback]: Check access state using HOSTINGER_VERIFY_DOMAIN_OWNERSHIP (confirm is_accessible before concluding misconfiguration).

[Optional (if project context is ambiguous)] [Prerequisite]: Action using VERCEL_GET_PROJECT2 (confirm the canonical project); if lookup fails or scope is unclear, discover candidates using VERCEL_GET_PROJECTS.
[Required] [Step]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS (list recent deployments for the project; follow pagination.next as needed) and select a target deployment uid plus high-level state.
[Required] [Step]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT (confirm authoritative status/readyState and capture error indicators and promotion signals such as aliasAssigned).
[Required (if readyState is non-terminal)] [Next Step]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT (poll until readyState becomes terminal, then record the final outcome, including READY/ERROR/CANCELED).
[Required] [Step]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_LOGS2 (retrieve a small runtime log tail first via maxLogs to reduce truncation/timeouts; increase only if needed).

[Fallback (if logs are empty, time out, or are not diagnostic)] [Fallback]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_EVENTS2 (fetch a bounded event slice to pinpoint the failing stage and extract actionable lines); if rollout looks gated, confirm via VERCEL_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_CHECKS.
known_pitfalls: [HOSTINGER_LIST_SUBSCRIPTIONS] Output may lack asset identifiers needed to link services to specific domains/sites without additional inventory calls.
[HOSTINGER_LIST_DOMAINS] Domain inventory can include items not tied to an active subscription; treat as a catalog, not an active-only view.
[HOSTINGER_LIST_DOMAINS] The domain list may contain multiple entries for the same domain with different type/status; deduplicate before downstream joins.
[HOSTINGER_LIST_WEBSITES] per_page is capped (max 100) and full results may require paging; rely on response meta (e.g., current_page/total) to stop.
[HOSTINGER_VERIFY_DOMAIN_OWNERSHIP] txt_to_verify can be empty when already accessible; use is_accessible rather than assuming a TXT challenge is always provided.
[VERCEL_GET_PROJECT2] Wrong scope commonly yields 403 Forbidden; downstream deployment/log calls may also fail until the correct scope is used.
[VERCEL_GET_PROJECTS] The limit parameter may validate as a string; type mismatches can trigger request validation errors.
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT] Using an incorrect idOrUrl can return 404 not_found; source identifiers from VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS.
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_LOGS2] Can return logs=[] or intermittently fail with HTTP 500 read timeout on large output.
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_EVENTS2] Payloads can be very large (e.g., requesting unbounded limits); keep limit/window tight and ensure parameter types validate.

HOSTINGER_LIST_SUBSCRIPTIONS.description: Get subscription list. Retrieve a list of all subscriptions associated with your account. Use this endpoint to monitor active services and billing status.

HOSTINGER_LIST_DOMAINS.description: Get domain list. Retrieve all domains associated with your account. Use this endpoint to view user's domain portfolio.

HOSTINGER_LIST_WEBSITES.description: List websites. Retrieve a paginated list of websites (main and addon types) accessible to the authenticated client. This endpoint returns websites from your hosting accounts as well as websites from other client hosting accounts that have shared access with you. Use the available query parameters to filter results by username, order ID, enabled status, or domain name for more targeted results.

per_page.description: Number of items per page (1-100). If not specified, the server's default will be used

from.description: Gets the deployment created after this Date timestamp. (default: current time)
